plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.error: Could not read all plugins, possibly due to a network problem
plugins.unavailable: This deployment runs without a manageable profile, so plugins cannot be installed or switched here.
plugins.chooseAddMethod: Choose how to add a plugin
plugins.installExistingDescription: Supports npm packages, Git repositories, and local directories
plugins.restartNotice: Restart DSH to apply the change. {reason}
plugins.restartReasonNoHmr: This profile applies changes only at startup.
plugins.restartReasonPackageMoved: An installed package now resolves to another directory, or the change replaces a package the DSH installation provides. Uninstall a package before installing it from another location.
plugins.restartReasonHostModule: The change reaches modules DSH itself loaded.
plugins.restartReasonUnmanagedPlugin: The change reaches a plugin running outside the plugin list.
plugins.restartReasonModuleComparison: DSH could not compare the loaded plugins with their files.
plugins.overriddenNotice: {name} was saved, but a higher-priority configuration overrides it, so it is not in effect
plugins.partsEmpty: This plugin pack contains no components.
plugins.installDescription: Enter the plugin's package name, GitHub repository address, or local directory path.
plugins.installGuideIdTitle: Enter the plugin's npm package name
plugins.installGuideIdHint: The plugin package name is the npm package name (like dsh-xxx or @author/plugin): the part after dsh plugin add or pnpm add in a community plugin's README install command.
plugins.installGitTemplateHint: Replace this with the actual Git repository address.
plugins.installPathTemplateHint: Replace this with the actual path to your local plugin directory.
plugins.installGuideSafety: Install only plugins you trust: they run with your permissions and can damage DeepSeek Harness or leak your data.
plugins.installUpgradeNotice: On-demand official plugins offer Update when their version differs from DSH. To update other plugins, uninstall and reinstall them.
plugins.registryLegend: The npm registry the plugin is downloaded from
plugins.registryCustomHint: Enter an internal or private npm registry address starting with http:// or https://. If it requires a login, store the credentials in ~/.npmrc on this machine.
plugins.registryCustomInvalid: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
plugins.installProblemInvalid: This is not a package name or address that can be installed: {reason}
plugins.installProblemInstalled: This plugin is already installed. To upgrade it, uninstall it and install it again
plugins.installProblemShipped: This plugin ships with DSH; upgrading DSH updates it
plugins.installBundledDescription: Enable it without downloading another copy
plugins.installProblemNotPackage: The path does not exist or is not a valid plugin package
plugins.installProblemNotBundle: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be installed as a plugin: {reason}
plugins.installProblemNetwork: The plugin registry could not be reached; check the network and try again
plugins.installProblemNetworkAll: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}); check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry
plugins.installProblemUnknown: The plugin could not be looked up: {reason}
plugins.versionsBlocked: Newer versions need a DSH update
plugins.versionsNoneInstallable: No newer version to install directly
plugins.versionsNoneInstallableDetail: The newer versions are deprecated, prereleases, or declare no bundle. Expand to see them
plugins.versionsNotBundle: This version declares no bundle and cannot be installed
plugins.versionsFallbackHint: {registry} could not be reached; the list comes from a fallback registry
plugins.versionsOmitted: {count} more versions newer than the installed one are not listed
plugins.updatesNone: All plugins are up to date
plugins.updatesFailed: Some plugins could not be checked
plugins.updateDescription: The update replaces {from} with {to}; the plugin may stop briefly. If the installation fails, {from} is kept or installed again.
plugins.updateRestart: {version} installed; it takes effect after a restart
plugins.updateRestoredDetail: {to} failed to install; {from} was installed again.
plugins.updateKeptDetail: {from} was not removed and stays in use. {reason}
plugins.updateBroken: Update failed; the plugin is not installed
plugins.updateBrokenDetail: {to} failed to install, and installing {from} again failed too. Install {name} again from Add plugin.
plugins.updateLostDetail: The connection to DSH was interrupted: {reason}. Refresh the plugin list to see the installed version.
plugins.installFailedTitle: The plugin could not be installed
plugins.installCancelAndEdit: Cancel installation and return to editing
plugins.installApplyingCancellationError: Cancellation was not confirmed. Installation is being applied; wait for its result. {reason}
plugins.installUnknownDescription: The Host has no active installation with this request id. Check the plugin list before trying again.
plugins.installResultUnconfirmed: The installation result was not received. Check installation status. {reason}
plugins.installAwaitingAcceptance: Waiting for the Host to accept installation. Cancellation will retry automatically after confirmation.
plugins.installBackgroundUnknown: Installation result unavailable. Check the plugin list.
plugins.installBackgroundUnconfirmed: Installation status is unconfirmed. View the installation for details.
plugins.installBackgroundApplying: Installation is being applied and cannot be cancelled. View installation progress.
plugins.installCancelled: Installation cancelled; the plugin is not enabled, and downloaded files may remain
plugins.installCancelUnconfirmed: Installation has not been confirmed stopped. Retry cancellation or wait for the installation result. {reason}
plugins.installDetailsNoOutput: No terminal output from this install reached the details
plugins.installAttempt: {previous} could not serve the package; retrying through {registry} (registry {index} of {total})
plugins.installFailureNetworkAll: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}). Check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry and retry.
plugins.installFailureNetworkHost: {host} could not be reached. A GitHub address or a .tgz link is not fetched through the registry: this machine must reach it directly or through a proxy. If the plugin is also published to npm, enter its package name instead.
plugins.installFailureDiskFull: The disk is full; the install stopped
plugins.installFailurePermission: No write permission; the plugin cannot be installed
plugins.installFailureBuildBlocked: A dependency's install scripts need your permission before the install can continue
plugins.installFailureBuildBlockedManual: pnpm blocked install scripts; allow them under allowBuilds in pnpm-workspace.yaml and retry
plugins.installFailureIntegrity: The downloaded package failed its integrity check
plugins.installFailurePnpmMissing: pnpm was not found, so nothing can be installed
plugins.installFailureGeneric: The install command failed; the details say why
plugins.installFailedEnabling: The install finished; enabling the plugin is what failed
plugins.installDoneNothing: Install finished with no new dependency.
plugins.installDoneRestart: Installed; restart DSH to load it. {reason}
plugins.installDoneOtherVersion: Under pnpm's supply-chain security policy (minimumReleaseAge), versions published more recently than the required age are not installed automatically, so this installation used {installed} instead of the latest version {version}. A newly published version has not completed this waiting period and may contain undetected malicious code or defects. If you need {version}, uninstall the current version and then install {exact} to request that version.
plugins.installApprovalDescription: These packages have install scripts that pnpm did not run.
plugins.installApprovalConsequence: Once allowed, the scripts run here with your permissions, and the permission is saved in this profile.
plugins.confirmUninstallDescription: What it provides goes away once it is uninstalled.
plugins.reasonManagementRequired: Plugin management needs it; it cannot be switched off or uninstalled.
plugins.reasonUnaddressable: The profile patch cannot address this one uniquely.
plugins.reasonInvalidSpec: Enter a valid package name or address.
plugins.reasonAlreadyInstalled: This package is already installed; uninstall it before installing another version.
plugins.reasonAmbiguousInstall: Which package was installed cannot be told from the dependency change.
plugins.reasonNotBundle: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be managed as a plugin.
plugins.reasonNotRemovable: This package is not owned by the profile, or plugin management needs it.
plugins.reasonStopProfile: This profile runs without HMR; stop it and uninstall the package with dsh plugin.
plugins.reasonBundleInUse: Other configuration still uses this bundle's components; switch them off first.
plugins.reasonStaleApproval: The pending script approvals changed; install again to refresh them.
plugins.reasonIncompatibleVersion: {plugin} is incompatible with DSH {runtime} (requires {requirements}); running it may cause crashes or data loss.
plugins.reasonIncompatibleVersionUnnamed: This plugin is incompatible with the running DSH version; running it may cause crashes or data loss.
plugins.reasonUnsupportedPlatform: This plugin does not support the operating system running DSH.
plugins.reasonIncompatibleInstall: Install a plugin version compatible with this DSH.
plugins.reasonIncompatibleInstalled: Uninstall it and install a version compatible with this DSH.
plugins.detailTooLarge: The details exceed the size limit and were not loaded.
plugins.detailNetwork: Could not reach the source of the details.
plugins.detailInvalid: The plugin declares an invalid details file.

account.title: Models
account.intro: Enter your API keys to use models from the following providers.
account.deleteDescription: Deleting {provider} removes its configuration. Any credential it uses is managed elsewhere and will be kept.
account.deleteDescriptionWithCredential: Deleting {provider} removes its configuration and stored API key.
account.addCatalogHint: Pick OpenAI, Anthropic, Kimi, or another provider from the built-in catalog and enter its API key.
account.addCustomHint: Connect a relay, a self-hosted server, or any other OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint by its base URL, protocol, and models.
account.addCatalogExhausted: Every catalog provider is already configured.
account.addCustomUnavailable: No API protocol is available to declare.
account.readOnly: The settings document is read-only in this deployment.
account.conflict: Someone else changed these settings while this card was open. Close it and reopen to edit the current values.
account.keyPlaceholderFallback: Leave blank to use env as auth ({hint})
account.keyPlaceholderSaved: Leave blank to use saved credentials
account.keyFallbackMissing: Env var not detected. Enter an API key, or configure {hint} in your env.
account.keyFallbackUnchecked: Environment credential status has not been confirmed.
account.keyHelp: Saved credentials are used first. Environment fallbacks shown here, in order: {env}. Sources are launch environment, $cwd/.env, then $DSH_HOME/.env.
account.deepSeekEndpointHint: Use an API endpoint compatible with Anthropic Messages.
account.modelNamePlaceholder: Uses the model ID when empty
account.modelReasoningHelpText: The API value is sent in the request's reasoning-effort field, such as OpenAI's reasoning_effort. It defaults to the level name; where the model provider's API documentation specifies a different value, follow it. Off turns reasoning off and needs no value; a value already written in the configuration is kept and sent.
account.modelReasoningNeedsLevel: Add at least one level besides Off, or turn reasoning levels off.
account.modelReasoningValueRequired: Every level besides Off needs an API value, and no value can be empty.
account.reorderModelHelp: Drag to reorder, or use the up and down arrow keys.
account.modelsEmpty: No models will be shown in the selector. Unlisted IDs can still be sent directly.
account.keyBlank: Enter the API key, or leave the field empty to keep the stored one.
account.keyBlankNew: Enter the API key, or leave the field empty if this provider authenticates another way.
account.keyIllegalCharacters: This API key is not in a valid format. Please check it.
account.modelContextInvalid: Context window must be a positive count, like 131072, 256K, or 1M.
account.modelMaxTokensInvalid: Max output tokens must be a positive count, like 8192, 64K, or 1M.
account.advancedHint: Other fields live in cordis.patch.yml; edit that section directly.
account.modelCapacityInvalid: A capacity must be a number, optionally suffixed K or M.
account.modelDuplicate: Each model ID may appear once.
account.fetchNeedsBaseUrl: Enter the base URL first, then fetch.
account.fetchEmpty: The provider listed no models. Add them by hand.
account.fetchDescription: These are the models this provider has available. Checked models make up the list.
account.fetchKeepOne: Keep at least one model checked.
account.customRouteHint: Lowercase identifier, starting with a letter, that uniquely names this provider in requests and as its credential name.
account.customRouteInvalid: Start with a lowercase letter; then lowercase letters, digits, and dashes.
account.customRouteTaken: A provider already uses this ID.
account.customNeedsBaseUrl: A custom provider needs a base URL.
account.customBaseUrlInvalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
account.customNeedsModels: A custom provider needs at least one model.
